title: The Best Protocol Ever!
author: April Clyburne-Sherin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.r73d9qn
materials: Draw a line between dots "A" and "B".
Draw a line between dots "B" and "C".
Draw a line between dots "C" and "D".
Draw a line between dots "D" and "E".
Draw a line between dots "C" and "F".
Draw a line between dots "D" and "G".
Draw a line between dots "C" and "G".
Draw a line between dots "A" and "C".
Give the triangle a smiley face!!!

steps.title: Gather Materials
steps.instruction: Acquire one 8.5" x 11" sheet of white paper and one black ballpoint pen.

steps.title: Draw Dot A
steps.instruction: Draw a small (1mm) dot in the top left corner of the paper, 1cm from the top and 1cm from the left edge; label it "A".

steps.title: Draw Dot B
steps.instruction: Draw a small (1mm) dot in the top left corner of the paper, 1cm from the top and 2cm from dot "A"; label it "B".

steps.title: Draw Dot C
steps.instruction: Draw a small (1mm) dot 2cm directly below dot "B"; label it "C".

steps.title: Draw Dot D
steps.instruction: Draw a small (1mm) dot 1cm directly to the right of dot "C"; label it "D".

steps.title: Draw Dot E
steps.instruction: Draw a small (1mm) dot 1cm directly above dot "D"; label it "E".

steps.title: Draw Dot F
steps.instruction: Draw a small (1mm) dot 2cm directly below dot "C"; label it "F".

steps.title: Draw Dot G
steps.instruction: Draw a small (1mm) dot 2cm directly below dot "D"; label it "G".

steps.title: Draw Final Symbol
steps.instruction: In the triangle formed between dots "A", "B", and "C", draw a small circle (2mm) with a dot inside the circle.
